checks_run: Inspected all 57 submitted files, including learner material, sealed reference code and tests, exercise answers, manifest, provenance, license boundary, and builder validation claims.
Ran a syntax check over every submitted JavaScript module with the pinned Node.js runtime.
Independently reran the public baseline, sealed reference suites, direct reference and adversarial tests, CLI parity smoke test, and pack audit.
Ran an independent 99-assertion matrix covering valid tree/VM behavior, runtime-error parity, syntax diagnostics, and ordinary malformed chunks.
Checked that parse, interpret, compile, and run do not mutate representative token, AST, or chunk inputs.
Probed the public VM with hostile opcode values and malformed span metadata.
Reviewed imports and source for external dependencies, eval, Function construction, network APIs, and subprocess APIs.
Checked manifest/provenance linkage, declared labels, file count, symlinks, and a before/after candidate-tree digest.
evidence: Pinned /arm/tools/nodejs/node/22.21.0/linux64/bin/node reports v22.21.0, and all submitted .mjs files pass node --check.
The intentionally incomplete public baseline exits 1 with 1 of 3 file suites passing; the sealed suite passes 2 of 2, with direct runs passing 13 of 13 reference tests and 3 of 3 adversarial tests.

Both sealed CLI backends exit 0 and print 8 for the recorded smoke program; environment/verify-pack.mjs reports PASS over 57 files with no forbidden paths, special files, symlinks, or credential-pattern matches.
The independent matrix passes 99 assertions across 28 successful backend executions, 14 runtime-error backend executions, 6 syntax-error programs, and 12 malformed chunks.

The sealed VM violates its malformed-chunk contract: a Symbol opcode escapes as TypeError, an opcode coercion hook executes and escapes as Error, and a string-valued span is accepted and propagated on MicaRuntimeError instead of being rejected as E_INVALID_BYTECODE.
Manifest and provenance project IDs, source IDs, source commits, and snapshot link agree; labels remain GENERATED and PARTIAL, productionized is false, and independent validation is REQUIRED.
The candidate tree digest remained 3fbf6052f35643da7d15f335abd14c661443545ef3bbccac788746e2b6124ccf throughout review.
limitations: The immutable upstream/catalog baseline is not present and network access is restricted, so the source hashes and no-copy claim cannot be independently recomputed or compared.

The full reviewer bundle contains sealed material; no separately materialized student view was supplied, so enforcement of sealed-file exclusion is outside this check even though the directory structure is logically separated.
No fuzzing, benchmark qualification, transfer verification, production-readiness assessment, or cross-platform/runtime matrix was performed or inferred.
git and rg are unavailable on PATH; deterministic file hashes, find, grep, and direct file inspection were used instead.
